title: Arbitration Act 1996: the tribunal's general duty
instrument: Arbitration Act 1996, ss. 33 and 68 (as amended by the Arbitration Act 2025)
description: The duty of an arbitral tribunal seated in England, Wales or Northern Ireland to act fairly.

requirements.title: Act fairly and impartially
requirements.text: The tribunal acts fairly and impartially between the parties, giving each a reasonable opportunity of putting its case and dealing with that of its opponent.
requirements.statement: Each party has had, or will have, a reasonable opportunity to deal with the material on which I rely, including any authority found by research.

requirements.title: Serious irregularity
requirements.text: A failure to comply with section 33 can be a serious irregularity on which an award is challenged.
